class.name: policy_framework/OnnxInference
class.description: Runs a float32 ONNX model with ONNX Runtime on CPU.

class.name: policy_framework/JointStateSource
class.description: sensor_msgs/JointState topic to joint position/velocity/effort entries.

class.name: policy_framework/TwistSource
class.description: geometry_msgs/Twist velocity command, zero when absent or stale.

class.name: policy_framework/OdometrySource
class.description: nav_msgs/Odometry topic to pose and twist entries.

class.name: policy_framework/ConcatPreprocessor
class.description: Concatenates state entries into one model input.

class.name: policy_framework/SplitPostprocessor
class.description: Writes each value of one model output to a command entry.

class.name: policy_framework/PdEffortExecutor
class.description: Controller-side joint PD law writing effort command interfaces.

class.name: policy_framework/ReferenceInterfaceExecutor
class.description: Controller-side copy of the commands to prefixed (e.g. chained reference) interfaces.

class.name: policy_framework/StateBoundsCheck
class.description: Fails when a state entry <prefix>/<interface> (e.g. a temperature or an error code) leaves its bounds.

class.name: policy_framework/JumpCheck
class.description: Fails when a state entry <prefix>/<interface> changes more than its max_delta between two cycles (e.g. an encoder glitch).

class.name: policy_framework/EncoderMismatchCheck
class.description: Fails when the <joint>/absolute_position and <joint>/position of a joint differ more than a tolerance (e.g. a slipping incremental encoder).

class.name: policy_framework/StateValueCheck
class.description: Fails while a state entry <prefix>/<interface> has one of its fault_values (e.g. an actuator mode in error, a false is_safe).

class.name: policy_framework/MockSafetyCheck
class.description: Fails on request from a policy_framework_msgs/msg/MockFault topic, to test the fault reactions.
